answer_1.quote: Given a pair of "before" I_bef and "after" I_aft images, ... we use a transformer decoder to decode it into sentences. ... The overall architecture of our method ... generate linguistic sentences that detail all of the changes.
answer_1.outputs: captions (natural language sentences describing image changes)

answer_2.quote: We follow the existing methods of multi-change captioning to use the five metrics for evaluating the generated sentences: BLEU-4 (B), METEOR (M), ROUGE-L (R), CIDEr (C) and SPICE (S).
